_comment: Overrides merged over packaging/meta.json by tools/build_var.py (all other fields, incl. licenseType, come from meta.json unchanged). Sources are generated by tools/make_person2.py.
description: AIBody Person 2 plugin for CHARACTER 2 (slot person2): a distinct copy of the AIBody Person plugin (own script class, own 'AIBody2' params) so the two characters can never be confused. Character 1 uses d0n.AIBodyPerson. Needs d0n.AIBodySession (Session Plugins) and the companion app.
instructions: Select character 2's Person atom > Plugins tab > Add Plugin > AddonPackages > d0n.AIBodyPerson2.<version>:/Custom/Scripts/d0n/AIBody2/AIBodyPerson2.cslist. Needs d0n.AIBodySession as session plugin and the companion. See https://github.com/d0n/vam_plugin
